title: An inactive part's window shows a grey Inactive pill in the title row
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Have an inactive part, part A.
  • Have an active part, part B, so the pill can be compared.
  • Start on the Inventory page (Parts in the top bar, then Inventory in the left menu), on the Inactive tab.
custom_steps:
1. Type part A's part number in the Search box.
  2. Click the part A row.
  3. Click the X at the top right of the window.
  4. Click the Active tab.
  5. Type part B's part number in the Search box.
  6. Click the part B row.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Part A is listed on the Inactive tab.

Step 2:

  • The window is titled "Edit Inventory Part" and shows a grey "Inactive" pill beside the close X.
  • Part Status has Inactive picked.

Step 3:

  • The window closes with nothing changed.

Step 4:

  • The Active tab is selected.

Step 5:

  • Part B is listed.

Step 6:

  • Part B's window shows a green "Active" pill in the same place.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, version 33 (23 Oct 2026, owner Chris Ward), read 27 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-10647, story SV-10822 (Story 9, Inactive Parts Cannot Be Added to New Work), story SV-10826 (Story 13, The Part Dialog)

  • S9-R14: “The part dialog of an inactive part shows the grey "Inactive" badge in its title row (S13-R3).”
  • S13-R3: “When editing, the title row shows the part's saved status as a pill beside the close X: "Active" in green, or "Inactive" in grey.”
